# Club Secretary

Email: [secretary@alnwickdolphins.com](mailto:secretary@alnwickdolphins.com)

The Club Secretary is key to the smooth running of the club. 
They provide a main point of contact for administration, information and communication.

## Key Responsibilities
- Be the main point of contact for the club
- Manage registration of the club with Swim England
- To maintain up-to-date contact details for all members, committee members, other 
key club personnel and Swim England secretaries at national, regional and county levels.
- Manage the provision of training vouchers for officials 
- Organise, attend and minute committee meetings and AGMs and distribute minutes
and agendas as necessary
- Communicate key information with club members e.g. pool closures
- Maintain and publicise the Club's Constitution

## Requirements
- Registration with Swim England
- Registration with Institute of Swimming

[Swim England role profile](https://www.swimming.org/library/documents/130/download)
